visual_bible.face: distinct individual faces, no repeated clone-like faces
visual_bible.anatomy: ordinary two-arm, two-leg human proportions with connected limbs
visual_bible.clothing: modest cream, ochre and muted olive dhotis or simple traditional cloth

never: no readable text or manuscript writing
no duplicated, fused or malformed people
no gloss, beams or metallic reflections

depiction_rules.notes: Unnamed figures supporting a devotional gathering; keep their number low and distinct.
